proof_chain.name: RankerRealCurvature.squared_gradient_completion_nonneg
proof_chain.statement: 0 <= squaredEuclideanNorm g + 2*mu*dot g v + mu^2*squaredEuclideanNorm v
proof_chain.premises: No positivity assumption on mu; g and v are arbitrary finite real coordinate vectors.
proof_chain.method: The expression equals squaredEuclideanNorm (fun j => g j + mu*v j). Expand finite sums coordinatewise by ring algebra and use the existing sum-of-squares nonnegativity theorem.

proof_chain.name: RankerRealCurvature.realObjective_scaled_gradient_domination
proof_chain.statement: 2*mu*(realObjective mu differences w - realObjective mu differences z) <= squaredEuclideanNorm (realCoordinateGradient mu differences w)
proof_chain.premises: n>0, mu>0, arbitrary differences,w,z. No minimizer or desired domination inequality is a premise.
proof_chain.method: Multiply the actual realObjective_lower_between inequality by nonnegative 2*mu. Complete squares at g=realCoordinateGradient mu differences w and v=z-w. Real arithmetic combines the two independently derived inequalities.

proof_chain.name: RankerRealCurvature.realObjective_gradient_domination
proof_chain.statement: realObjective mu differences w - realObjective mu differences z <= squaredEuclideanNorm (realCoordinateGradient mu differences w)/(2*mu)
proof_chain.premises: Same primitive premises as the scaled theorem.
proof_chain.method: Divide the proved scaled inequality by positive 2*mu.

proof_chain.name: RankerRealCurvature.originalReal_scaled_gradient_domination
proof_chain.premises: Arbitrary original Fin 80 real-coordinate w,z; all data and scalars are the already joined original real profile.
proof_chain.method: Specialize generic scaled domination with n=4 and originalReal_mu_pos.

proof_chain.name: RankerRealCurvature.originalReal_gradient_domination
proof_chain.method: Specialize generic divided domination with n=4 and originalReal_mu_pos.

noncircularity.use_after_actual_minimizer_exists: Instantiate z with the independently proved global minimizer. The upper PL bound already holds for every z; minimizer existence provides an actual z and nonnegativity of the objective gap.
